description:
For 28 years, Min-seo has never been in a relationship. Hoping to finally create a new connection, he sets off on a package tour full of excitement. But the partner he’s matched with spends the entire trip glued to his phone, showing nothing but disinterest. After a big fight, Min-seo is left on his own, fidgeting with the pointless “love kit” he got as part of the tour package… when suddenly, someone grabs his shoulder. Startled, he turns around to see a bespectacled man he’s never met before. With clear nervousness on his face, the stranger meets Min-seo’s equally flustered gaze and blurts out:

*“Are you Korean?!”*
